column1: # Reviewed 2026-09-01 for TRK-38 against the 2026-08-06 baseline. Exact Go 1.26.6
# +28.53%). Reproducible `go tool nm -size` attribution against the checkpoint
# source identifies non-TLS growth in httpapi (+453265), connectorprotocol
# and x/net/idna (+45444) bytes. Certificate/TLS packages are measured but
# excluded from this non-TLS ownership attribution per TRK-38 scope. The
# remaining measured growth includes Go runtime/linker/static data and newly
# reachable feature code. Updating a size requires this attribution.
